# MobileMart Verified Smartphone Exchange

> MobileMart is a peer-to-peer marketplace for verified smartphones, factory sealed devices, and certified pre-owned hardware.

## Overview
- **Platform Type**: Peer-to-peer smartphone exchange.
- **Settlement Model**: Direct buyer-seller settlement in-person at safe public locations upon hardware inspection.
- **Verification**: 90-point diagnostic standards, clean IMEI verification, transparent battery health reporting.
- **Key Categories**: Factory Sealed New, Certified Pre-Owned (Pristine, Excellent, Good).
